neighborhoods.name: Seacroft
neighborhoods.notes: seafront conservation area with period properties

property_mix.notable: high density of holiday rental properties and guest houses; Victorian seafront terraces with period locks

locksmith_relevant: Seafront conservation properties have original period locks requiring specialist knowledge and restoration-compliant repairs.
Seasonal holiday let turnover drives frequent lock changes, rekeying, and master key system installations for guest access.
Older terraced housing stock often features worn Victorian and Edwardian mechanisms needing careful handling or period-appropriate replacement.
